construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in this isolated build directory

input.customer: Required object: nonblank name, goal, experience (beginner or experienced)
input.fixture_label: Optional nonblank source label; example explicitly labeled SYNTHETIC
input.steps: Optional ordered list of 1-100 steps; omitted selects three general-purpose defaults. Each step requires unique id, title, instruction, requires (list of prerequisite IDs), completed (boolean). Text fields trim whitespace and are limited to 1000 characters.

output.success: schema_version=1, status=ok, fixture_label, normalized customer, onboarding_status (in_progress or complete), progress (completed/total/percent), next_step (id/title/instruction/guidance/reason or null), personalized message
output.error: schema_version=1, status=error, error (human-readable text); CLI exits 2

shared_schema.validation: One validate function shared by Python API and CLI; strict object fields, types, prerequisite references, unique IDs/dependencies, acyclic graph, completed prerequisite consistency. JSON loader rejects duplicate keys and non-finite constants.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single functionality: JSON decoding -> shared validation and normalization -> deterministic next-step selection -> shared output envelope. No external stages.
behavior: Select the earliest unfinished step in supplied order whose prerequisites are complete; supplied order breaks ties.
Personalize the next action with customer name, goal, and experience-sensitive guidance.
All steps completed yields explicit completion, 100 percent progress and no next step.
No implicit progress mutation; callers supply updated completion state on each invocation.
Input objects remain unchanged. Identical inputs produce identical outputs.
